mapper.select: WITH RankedQuotes AS (SELECT id, supplier_code AS supplierCode, product_code AS productCode, unit_price AS unitPrice, update_time AS updateTime, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY product_code ORDER BY unit_price ASC, update_time ASC ) AS rankNum FROM quotation WHERE product_code = #{productCode} AND outdated = 0 AND deleted = 0) SELECT * FROM RankedQuotes ORDER BY rankNum ASC
